newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy evacuates 18 from Albanian port of Vlore.
newsitem.headline: Italy evacuates 18 from Albanian port of Vlore.

text.p: Italy evacuated 18 people from the troubled southern Albanian port of Vlore on Saturday, its second such rescue mission within a week, the naval ministry said.

A spokesman told Reuters that helicopters had been sent to Vlore from a navy ship stationed in the Adriatic. The 18 people, who were all safe, were brought back to the ship and were being transferred by boat to the southern Italian port of Brindisi.
The foreign ministry later said in a statement that the operation had been carried out on Saturday morning in conjunction with the defence ministry and with the consent of the Albanian authorities.

A foreign ministry spokesman said about a dozen Italians were on board accompanied by several Albanian relatives. He said a number of Albanians who had helped the Italian community in Vlore were also evacuated, but had no precise details.
Italy on Monday evacuated 35 people from Vlore and the foreign ministry said very few Italians now remained in southern Albania, where armed rebels have mounted an insurrection.
The statement said Italy had also arranged for food and medicines to be sent to a hospital in Vlore run by Italian nuns.
